name: 13_fx
description: EUR income reported in USDC through the EUR/USD rate accumulator (snapshots on trading days only): a normally covered quarter whose average is read from the live end checkpoint, a low-coverage quarter (40 of 65 trading days → attestor-signed fallback rate), a quarter flagged for a >2% Pyth/Chainlink deviation (fallback), a fourth normal quarter; pair registration is write-once; FX reverts included.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.

steps.note: EUR/USD, quoted USD per EUR, Chainlink cross-check configured; pair id = keccak256(feed_id ‖ 0x00)
feed id and direction are write-once
θ = 80,000 EUR at 6 decimals (income scale), currency 978
first snapshot of Q1 creates the Q1 checkpoint (sums 0)
same day: the day check comes first
stablecoin-rate shortcut is wrong for an FX series
the accumulator is valid for Q1
live end checkpoint: owed 4% × 30,000 EUR = 1,200 EUR × avg(54 rates) → USDC, floor
Q1 paid: 1302180000 USDC; coverage 54/64 trading days
publish_time older than 3600 s
first snapshot of Q2 stores the Q1 end checkpoint; the stored average equals the live one
Q1 average unchanged once the checkpoint is stored
first snapshot of Q3 closes Q2 with 40 of 65 trading days → NeedsFallback
Q2 NeedsFallback (coverage 40/65)
low coverage: an attestor-signed rate is required
the fallback rate must be signed by an attestor
fallback rate 1.09 signed by attestor1 (MERCES_FX_V1 message); payment 2,000 EUR → 2,180 USDC
Chainlink 1.133 vs Pyth 1.10: 3% > 2% band → period flagged
first snapshot of Q4 closes Q3
Q3 covered 64 of 66 trading days but flagged → NeedsFallback
deviation fallback at 1.10: 1,600 EUR → 1,760 USDC
live end checkpoint, average 1.11 exactly: 2,000 EUR → 2,220 USDC
